posts.title: weird guy on the bus
posts.description: today there was a weird guy on the bus. he was a normal guy really but he was wearing a bright pink helmet and on the seat next to him was a big cubic bag that said DOOR DASH. so he wasnt weird but it was weird he was on the bus and not on a bike or scooter or hog. and he wasnt just weird, he was dishonest. the whole appeal of food delivery is the outsourcing of petty fuel and labour. we like that

posts.title: nature's herbert
posts.description: at the fancy iga a man is handing out samples of a miscellaneous substance. his bright orange shirt says nature's s herbert . the name on his badge says: herbert. "jim latte?" herbert asks. "jim latte? jim latte?" no one obliges him by taking a paper cup. the labels inform me that there are three choices in total: jim latte, jon macchiato and something called "alf cappuccino". "jim latte?" he asks

posts.title: no more gemstones
posts.description: for a while i wrote in a purple notebook. nothing interesting, just a diary. highlight of the day, what happened, weekend plans, etcetera. i kept it up five months and then fell out of practice.. at first accidentally and then intentionally. i decided that not writing was a way to rebel against my present, future and past-in-hindsight selves. fuckem! even if it was a gemstone day, a day that shone
